# happenin

> A minimal macOS CLI that captures Cursor and Claude Code agent events into a local SQLite database and serves a realtime dashboard.

Important notes:

- Development of this repository requires [Nub](https://nubjs.com); end users will be able to install the published package with npm once it ships.
- The CLI exposes `install`, `record`, `import`, and `dashboard` commands.
- There are zero runtime dependencies; the dashboard loads small client libraries (htmx, AlpineJS, htmx-ext-sse) from a CDN.

## User docs

- [README.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/YogliB/happenin/main/README.md): Overview, quick start, commands, and usage.
- [docs/ARCHITECTURE.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/YogliB/happenin/main/docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): Data flow and design choices.

## Contributor docs

- [AGENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/YogliB/happenin/main/AGENTS.md): Entry point for coding agents; setup, scripts, and key files.

## Implementation

- [src/bin.ts](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/YogliB/happenin/main/src/bin.ts): CLI executable entry point.
- [src/index.ts](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/YogliB/happenin/main/src/index.ts): CLI dispatch for `install`, `record`, `import`, `dashboard`, `--help`, and `--version`.
- [src/db.ts](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/YogliB/happenin/main/src/db.ts): SQLite data layer.
- [src/record.ts](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/YogliB/happenin/main/src/record.ts): Hook target; reads JSON from stdin and stores an event.
- [src/install.ts](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/YogliB/happenin/main/src/install.ts): Backs up and appends hooks to Cursor and Claude Code configs.
- [src/import.ts](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/YogliB/happenin/main/src/import.ts): Imports Claude and Cursor transcripts.
- [src/dashboard.ts](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/YogliB/happenin/main/src/dashboard.ts): HTTP server and dashboard HTML.
- [src/constants.ts](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/YogliB/happenin/main/src/constants.ts): Hook event lists and default responses.
- [src/types.ts](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/YogliB/happenin/main/src/types.ts): Shared TypeScript types.

## Optional

- [assets/help.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/YogliB/happenin/main/assets/help.md): Help text shown by `--help`.
- [package.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/YogliB/happenin/main/package.json): Scripts, dependencies, engines, and package metadata.
- [LICENSE.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/YogliB/happenin/main/LICENSE.md): MIT license.
